summary.text: Mary Messier is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 62 since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an educator by profession, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Messier earned a B.A. from Roger Williams University and an M.Ed. from Rhode Island College.
